hints.title: Character Offset Balance
hints.text: Maintain an offset difference representing the pending character balance between the two strings.

hints.title: Wildcard Consumption
hints.text: A positive difference indicates the first string has remaining wildcard length to consume from the second string.

hints.title: Memoized Search Tuple
hints.text: Memoize search states based on pointer indices in both strings and the signed difference offset.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N * M * K) memoized state search
variables: K: range of pending difference offset
complexity.notes: Maintains signed offset difference of wildcard characters consumed.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Expanding all wildcard numeric combinations creates exponential string expansions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoizing (i, j, diff) state tuples collapses redundant paths.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should define the differential state tracking character balances.
